reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses the P-based glass-former limitation by partially substituting P with B, a well-known metalloid for enhancing glass-forming ability in metal-metalloid systems, and provides a clear, testable mechanism (atomic size mismatch, viscosity increase) with a specific falsification experiment. Hypothesis B proposes W addition, but the cited evidence (E2) is from an Fe-P-based system without Cr, Mn, Co, Ni, and the mechanism relies on W-P mixing enthalpy, which is less directly transferable to this complex high-entropy alloy and may risk forming unwanted phases.
